command.mac: In this Claude session, make one real page database write (an ArtifactData set on a throwaway doc) to my waiting page at https://claude.ai/artifact/RddcgXbB6SvTrFZHPmsvFx, in collection probe, doc id probe-slug-1. Show me the raw input exactly as sent, including the slug value, and the full response. Then answer: (1) what url came back, and is it exactly https://claude.ai/artifact/RddcgXbB6SvTrFZHPmsvFx? If not, which artifact did the write go to? (2) Is the slug the same text as the last part of that url (RddcgXbB6SvTrFZHPmsvFx)? (3) How did you find the slug: a tool, a file, a setting, or the url? Name it. Then delete the doc and confirm it is gone.

context:
Goal: the guards for page writes also fire when a Mac session writes your page.
Problem (goal): your last Mac probe sent slug 1bd74a4d-765f-4c93-9d82-0b031ad3ffb7 and got back url .../artifact/4SQAxJxPgPMiYX8deXXx8v, but this page is .../artifact/RddcgXbB6SvTrFZHPmsvFx. If the slug is a different name from the page's id, the guard cannot find your page from a Mac write, and the fix is bigger. Nobody knows whether that Mac write even reached this page.
Based on (read): your item 626 answer (Mac session, 19:58 CST Nov 13) and the lane's read of the guard (waiting_page_root matches the page id from the call's url; a Mac write has no url).
Departs from: main — main's guards cannot see a Mac page write; the lane adds guarding for it.
Meanwhile: the lane builds nothing on this until you answer; no other work waits.
lastAnswer: 793: done, note "mac is on another acc" with the Mac session's report, at 20:09 CST Nov 13.

reply: Done. Your Mac is on another account: the URL of this page matches none of its 60 artifacts, so a Mac session cannot write this page. Its write went to "home waiting page" (slug 1bd74a4d-..., url 4SQAx...), a different artifact. The slug is a UUID that differs from the url's last part; the tool takes the UUID or the full url. The lane has the full report.
short: Mac: write to the real page and report the slug
title: On your Mac: write one throwaway doc to the real waiting page and report the slug it used
why: Only a Mac session has these tools. The lane needs one fact the code cannot give: whether the slug a Mac write sends is the page's own id.
